menu: it drew itself with `--shadow-lg`, which the palette never declared, so it
floated over the transcript with no shadow at all. Declared one step above
`--shadow-md` in both themes, which is what a popover over unknown content needs.

commits.author: Giulio Ardoino
commits.subject: fix(web): copy what the bubble actually shows
commits.body:
Both copy options did nothing on the hosted app, and they took the clipboard's
previous contents with them.

The menu was handed one message and read `text` off it, which `extractText`
builds from `type: "text"` parts alone. A bubble whose parts are a thought and a
tool call has none, so the text was `""` — and `writeText("")` does not fail, it
succeeds and leaves an empty clipboard. Nothing to paste, and whatever had been
copied a moment earlier gone as well. Selecting by hand did not help either: the
bubble was preventing the context menu to show its own, so the browser's Copy was
not on offer.

A run made this worse. The bubble shows every message in the run, and the menu
was given `[...messagesByID.values()].pop()`: the last one, which for a run that
ends on a tool call carries no text at all. So the copy was empty exactly where
the transcript was fullest.

The menu now takes the text to copy rather than a message, and a run hands over
all of its messages joined. With nothing to copy the bubble adds no handlers, so
the browser keeps its own menu and a hand-made selection can still be copied.
An empty write is refused outright, and the `execCommand` carrier gives the
selection back after borrowing it.
